name: MCP BigQuery Analyst Evaluation
description: Evaluates the MCP-based BigQuery analytics agent on schema exploration, revenue analysis, customer segmentation, and product performance queries.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What tables are available in the grocery dataset?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After listing tables, ask for the schema of fact_transactions. Then ask what relationships exist between the fact and dimension tables.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What is the total revenue by store?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask which store has the highest revenue per square foot. Then ask about revenue trends over the last few months.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: How are customers distributed across loyalty tiers?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask about the average spend per loyalty tier. Then ask which tier has the highest transaction frequency.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Which product categories have the highest profit margins?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask about the bottom 3 products by margin. Then suggest which products should be featured in upcoming promotions.
